notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Dockside Extortionist, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping those, adding four mana of any color.
Activate Grim Monolith's last ability by paying {4}, untapping it.
Repeat.
